title: Unit Econ Reconciliation Sheet — Dashboard vs Billing/Metering (Daily)
collaborators: Nadia Rahman, Caleb Johnson, Rishi Malhotra, Vanessa Ortiz, Aisha Bello
tags: unit-econ, reconciliation, billing, metering, dashboard, variance, finance, data-quality

content:
Purpose
- Daily tie-out between Unit Economics dashboard totals and Billing/Metering totals.
- Primary KPI: blended_cost_usd_per_1m_output_tokens (dashboard) reconciled to billing-derived effective COGS proxy by the same day/region/tier.
- Used by Finance (FP&A) and Eng Platform to validate attribution correctness, catch regressions (region mapping, discounts/credits policy, late metering), and decide when to backfill.

Scope / What this includes
- Regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west
- Customer tiers: self_serve, dedicated, private, enterprise
- Metric basis: USD totals and derived $/1M output tokens.
- Grain: day x region x tier.

Data sources (current)
- Dashboard totals: analytics.unit_econ_daily (semantic layer view) filtered to finalized partitions; uses blended compute + overhead allocation.
- Billing/Metering totals: billing.daily_token_costs (metering events joined to pricing tables; net of credits/discounts per Finance policy).
- Known reconciliation gotchas:
  - Late-arriving metering events (commonly 2–24h; occasionally 48h) can shift billing totals after dashboard partition is computed.
  - Region mapping differences (billing uses invoice_region; dashboard uses runtime_region with mapping table). See SUP-8841.
  - Credits/discount policy: dashboard currently reports "gross" and "net" variants; this sheet reconciles to NET unless otherwise noted.
  - Dedicated: some costs are capacity-allocated; billing uses contract allocation logic that can lag by 1 day.

Tolerance / pass-fail
- Default tolerance: abs(variance_pct) <= 1.5% AND abs(variance_usd) <= $1,000 per day/region/tier.
- Escalation thresholds:
  - Warn: > 1.5% and <= 3% (or >$1k and <=$5k)
  - Page/Incident-like: > 3% OR >$5k for any slice OR > 1% at global total for 2 consecutive days

Column definitions
- dashboard_total_usd: total blended cost USD shown in dashboard for slice (net variant)
- billing_total_usd: billing-derived USD for same slice/day
- variance_usd = dashboard_total_usd - billing_total_usd
- variance_pct = variance_usd / billing_total_usd
- status: PASS | WARN | FAIL | HOLD (HOLD = known issue; awaiting backfill or upstream fix)
- notes: short driver + link(s) where possible

Variance notes / narrative log (most recent first)
- 2025-02-11: eu-west mapping fix + backfill applied. Variance dropped from ~3% to ~1.3% and then <1%. Action: close SUP-8841 loop once 7-day stability confirmed.
- 2025-02-06: us-west self_serve WARN attributed to cache metrics ingestion gap causing dashboard to under-count cache savings. Not a billing error; dashboard attribution error. Waiting on deployment of cache savings attribution changes (ref: PR-11884). If still present after deploy, schedule a 90-day backfill (ENG-2918).
- 2025-02-04 to 2025-02-10: eu-west self_serve elevated variance due to invoice_region/runtime_region mapping mismatch + late metering. Mitigation applied: temporarily exclude >24h-late partitions from reconciliation job to prevent false FAILs (documented in Slack eng-platform 1706639020).

Open questions (needs decisions)
1) Dedicated netting policy: Billing applies contract credits differently than dashboard net view for some enterprise-dedicated hybrids. Do we need a separate "billing_net_policy_version" dimension in semantic layer?
2) When metering events arrive late (>24h), should dashboard restate historical day partitions automatically (daily rolling recompute), or only via manual backfill runbook?
3) Finance wants a stable weekly number. Do we lock "settled" days as T-2 to reduce churn?

Next actions
- Cole Summers: confirm with Rishi/Laura that this sheet should reconcile to NET by default; document exception cases in KPI guide.
- Nadia Rahman: ensure region mapping table uses invoice_region canonical values; add unit test covering eu-west vs eu-west-1. (Related: ENG-2911)
- Caleb Johnson: add alert annotation in dashboard when a day is not "settled" (late event risk) so Finance doesn’t screenshot volatile numbers.
- Aisha Bello: wire reconciliation FAIL to #eng-sre and #eng-platform with runbook link + top 5 failing slices.

Notes to self / operational
- If a slice FAILs but global remains PASS: still investigate if it’s a single high-value customer cohort (enterprise/dedicated) because it can mask localized issues.
- Always check if pricing table changed (new discount schedule) before chasing pipeline bugs.
